[IARC.7.13] **Float text is vendored, not written.** libds converts between
`Float` and decimal text ([LDET.3.2.8]) with published, proven code and none of
its own: Dragonbox's `to_chars` with its compact cache renders the shortest
text, and fast_float parses text. Both are vendored unmodified, at pinned
releases, with every file's digest recorded beside them. A fixed precision
([LGRA.2.9.6.10]) is rounded from the binary value by exact integer arithmetic,
with no table and no allocation. The compiler and the second runtime in this
repository call the same vendored code, so a value computed at compile time
and at run time has one definition ([LDET.3.3a.8]).
